scripts.build: cd ../frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.postinstall: npm run build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const distSrc = path.join(__dirname, '../frontend/dist'); const distDest = path.join(__dirname, 'dist'); console.log('Copying from:', distSrc, 'to:', distDest); try { if (fs.existsSync(distSrc)) { fs.cpSync(distSrc, distDest, {recursive: true, force: true}); console.log('Frontend build copied successfully'); } else { console.log('Source dist folder not found'); } } catch(e) { console.log('Copy failed:', e.message); }"
